The sdk_*.py.txt fixtures are bl-sdk/mods_base source (line endings normalized to LF), retrieved from its public repository on 2026-10-23. They are covered by GNU LGPL version 3; the LGPL and incorporated GPL license texts accompany them. These fixtures are not installed into the game. verify_keybinds.py executes them with stub game services; on Python 3.12 it parenthesizes the newer except-list syntax and supplies an identity-only warnings.deprecated decorator. The SDK keybind, option and persistence behavior itself is executed unchanged. Upstream: https://github.com/bl-sdk/mods_base

The additional sdk_mod_factory.py.txt is upstream source with LF line endings fetched on 2026-10-24. Its exact Git blob identity and URL are recorded in sdk_mod_factory_source.json. verify_versioning.py executes it with game/registration boundary doubles; version parsing and pyproject injection remain unchanged. version_guard.py also runs its original parser expression at build time.
